title: Food & drinks
practiceFocus: Pretend to order a meal in Spanish

points.title: Enough grammar to order
points.rule: Quiero from day 4 takes a thing or a verb. Un goes before a masculine noun and una before a feminine one: un café, una ensalada. Staff may say desea or recomienda. Answer with quiero. Soy vegetariano uses ser from day 3, with -o or -a like ingeniero.

grammar.notYet: Gustar, object pronouns, and the usted verb table. Está delicioso is one fixed sentence, not a reason to study estar.

phrases.spanish: Una mesa para dos, por favor.

phrases.english: I want a coffee with milk.

phrases.note: A fixed question for staff. Answer their next question with quiero.
Say the whole sentence. The estar table comes later.
Vegetariana if you use the -a ending, like profesora.

lines.speaker: Camarero
lines.english: Good afternoon. A table for how many?

lines.speaker: Camarero
lines.english: What would you like to drink?

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.spanish: Agua y un café, por favor.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.spanish: Quiero una tortilla y una ensalada.
lines.english: I want an omelette and a salad.

practice.title: Order a meal
practice.instruction: Role-play walking into a restaurant, sitting down, ordering food and drink, then asking for the bill.
starters: Hola, una mesa para uno, por favor.
tips: Por favor and gracias do a lot of work.
If you freeze, point at the menu and say esto, por favor.
